import novamind_api as nm

print("=== A. FIRST-REBILL CHURN: cohort d146-152 (rebilled d176-182) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan,
  COUNT(*) cohort,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 176 AND 182 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) canc_this_wk,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) still_sub
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_type='small' AND s.start_day BETWEEN 146 AND 152 AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan HAVING cohort >= 80 ORDER BY cohort DESC
""")
for row in r['rows']:
    rate = row['canc_this_wk']/row['cohort']*100
    print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} {row['plan']} cohort {row['cohort']:6d} canc {row['canc_this_wk']:5d} ({rate:.0f}%) still {row['still_sub']}")

print("\n=== A2. ALL cancels d176-182 by group/plan ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 176 AND 182
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 15
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

print("\n=== A3. Cancels by tenure bucket (this week) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT CASE WHEN s.end_day - s.start_day <= 35 THEN '1st_cycle'
            WHEN s.end_day - s.start_day <= 65 THEN '2nd_cycle'
            ELSE 'veteran' END bucket, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 176 AND 182
GROUP BY bucket
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

print("\n=== B. Conversion by week x group (wk24,25,26) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, (s.start_day-1)/7 wk, COUNT(*) leads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) subs
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_type='small' AND s.start_day >= 162
GROUP BY c.group_id, wk ORDER BY c.group_id, wk
""")
for row in r['rows']:
    conv = row['subs']/row['leads']*100 if row['leads'] else 0
    print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} wk{row['wk']}: leads {row['leads']:6d} subs {row['subs']:6d} conv {conv:.0f}%")

print("\n=== C. Cash ledger this week by type ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT entry_type, SUM(amount) total, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger
WHERE day BETWEEN 176 AND 182 GROUP BY entry_type ORDER BY total
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"{row['entry_type']:25s} {row['total']:14,.0f}  n={row['n']}")

print("\n=== D. Open issues by group (open_day based age) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) n, AVG(182 - i.open_day) avg_age
FROM issues i JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id
WHERE i.resolved_day IS NULL GROUP BY c.group_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 8
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} open {row['n']:6d} avg_age {row['avg_age']:.1f}d")

print("\n=== E. Active book by group/plan ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.effective_price) mrr
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan HAVING n>300 ORDER BY mrr DESC
""")
tot=0
for row in r['rows']:
    tot+=row['mrr']
    print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} {row['plan']} n={row['n']:6d} gross_mrr=${row['mrr']:11,.0f}")
print(f"TOTAL listed gross MRR: ${tot:,.0f}")

import novamind_api as nm

print("=== C. Cash ledger this week by category ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT category, SUM(amount) total, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger
WHERE day BETWEEN 176 AND 182 GROUP BY category ORDER BY total
""")
net=0
for row in r['rows']:
    net+=row['total']
    print(f"{row['category']:25s} {row['total']:14,.0f}  n={row['n']}")
print(f"NET: {net:,.0f}")

print("\n=== D. Open issues by group ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) n, AVG(182 - i.open_day) avg_age
FROM issues i JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id
WHERE i.resolved_day IS NULL GROUP BY c.group_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 8
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} open {row['n']:6d} avg_age {row['avg_age']:.1f}d")

print("\n=== E. Active book by group/plan ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.effective_price) mrr
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan HAVING n>200 ORDER BY mrr DESC
""")
tot=0
for row in r['rows']:
    tot+=row['mrr']
    print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} {row['plan']} n={row['n']:6d} gross_mrr=${row['mrr']:11,.0f}")
print(f"TOTAL listed gross MRR: ${tot:,.0f}")

print("\n=== F. CPL by channel x group this week (ad_channel_leads) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT channel_id, group_id, COUNT(*) leads FROM ad_channel_leads
WHERE day BETWEEN 176 AND 182 GROUP BY channel_id, group_id ORDER BY leads DESC LIMIT 15
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

print("\n=== G. Usage & est compute by group/plan (yesterday d181) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(DISTINCT u.customer_id) users, SUM(u.usage_units) tot_units, AVG(u.usage_units) avg_u
FROM daily_usage u JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=u.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=u.customer_id
WHERE u.day = 181 GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan HAVING users>200 ORDER BY tot_units DESC
""")
